> [!CAUTION]
> This release includes mitigations for the recent [eMudhra CA compromise](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/) as well as general dependency upgrades. While we don't believe RomM instances are vulnerable, we recommend upgrading as soon as possible.

## What's Changed
* docs(readme): move corporate sponsors above friends by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5219
* chore(deps-dev): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5221
* fix(deps): bump certifi to 2026.10.19 to distrust compromised eMudhra intermediates by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5283
* chore(deps): bump uv to 0.13.4 by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5284
* chore(trunk): Upgrade trunk by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5225
* chore(deps): update github actions by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5244
* chore(deps): bump aiohttp from 3.14.3 to 3.14.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5276
* chore(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.3.1 to 8.3.4 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5285
* chore(deps): bump follow-redirects from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5286
* docs: list the ROM patcher env vars in env.template by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5265
* chore(deps): update dependency pillow to v13 [security] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5288
* chore(deps): update dependency storybook to v10.6.2 [security] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5291
* chore(deps): bump Node to 24.22.1 for the October 2026 security release by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5295
* fix(docker): upgrade the image's pip to 26.2.2 by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5298
* chore(deps): update github/codeql-action action to v4.39.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5299

## New Contributors
* @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5265

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rommapp/romm/compare/5.4.0...5.4.1

detail.readme:
A beautiful, powerful, self-hosted ROM manager and player.


# Overview Scan, enrich, browse and play your ROM collection from one beautiful & free self-hosted app. Metadata from 10+ providers, save sync across your devices, and support for over 400 platforms. RomM is a must-have for anyone who plays on emulators.

## Features - Play in your browser with [EmulatorJS][docs-emulatorjs] and [RuffleRS][docs-rufflers], no setup required - Keep [saves and states][docs-saves] in sync across your devices, with conflict resolution - Scan and enrich your library with metadata from [IGDB][igdb-api], [Screenscraper][screenscraper-api], [LaunchBox][launchbox-api] and [MobyGames][mobygames-api] - Fetch custom artwork from [SteamGridDB][steamgriddb-api] and track your achievements from [Retroachievements][retroachievements-api] - Metadata available for [400+ platforms][docs-supported-platforms], plus multi-disk games, DLCs, mods, hacks and manuals - Apply romhacks and translations on the fly with the built-in [ROM patcher][docs-rom-patcher] - Share your library with granular [per-user permissions][docs-users-and-roles] and [OIDC single sign-on][docs-oidc] - Official apps for [Playnite][playnite-app], [Android][argosy-launcher] and [CFWs][grout] - Free forever: AGPL-3.0, no tracking, no paid features, and total control of your data ## Installation The easiest way to start is with the [Quick Start Guide][docs-quick-start-guide] in the docs. If you're having trouble with setup, please review the page for [troubleshooting steps][docs-troubleshooting]. Prefer a hosted deploy over wiring up the stack yourself?

Starting at $6.49/mo · Setup guide
Starting at $2.30/mo · Setup guide
Deployment and infrastructure support for these installs is handled by Hostinger and CoreHost. Prices are indicative and may not reflect current offerings. Both send a share of the revenue back to us, which helps fund the project. ## Official apps ### Playnite plugin Effortlessly integrate your retro game collection into [Playnite](https://playnite.link/), the open-source game library manager that provides a unified interface for all of your games on PC. `Windows` `Desktop` `QR pairing`   by @gantoine
### Argosy Sync your library, download games on demand and track your achievements, from a gamepad-first interface designed for Anbernic, Retroid Pocket, Odin, and similar devices. `Android` `Handhelds` `QR pairing` `Save sync`   by @tmgast
### Grout A lightweight client for your favorite handheld custom firmwares*. Download games, box art and BIOS files wirelessly, and sync your saves automatically as you play. `Linux` `Handhelds` `Save sync`   by @BrandonKowalski *Supports Allium, Batocera, Knulli, MinUI, muOS, NextUI, Onion, ROCKNIX, Spruce and TrimUI. ## Community Here are some cool projects maintained by members of our community. Please note that our team does not regularly review their source code. ### Mobile and TV - [R-Shop][r-shop]: Controller-first game manager for Android handhelds and TVs by [@AverageConsumer](https://github.com/AverageConsumer) - [romm-ios-app][romm-ios-app]: Native iOS app by [@ilyas-hallak](https://github.com/ilyas-hallak) - [RomMMobile][rommmobile]: Android app that downloads games into your existing frontend's folders by [@pippopapera](https://github.com/pippopapera) - [RomMulus][rommulus]: Android TV app with built-in emulator cores and save sync by [@DEV-DUFORD](https://github.com/DEV-DUFORD) ### Desktop - [Freegosy][freegosy]: Cross-platform game manager with save sync by [@abduznik](https://github.com/abduznik) - [RetroVault][retrovault]: Native macOS library and player by [@kennethreitz](https://github.com/kennethreitz) - [romm-client][romm-client]: Desktop client by [@chaun14](https://github.com/chaun14) - [RomMate][rommate]: Desktop app for browsing your collection by [@brenoprata10](https://github.com/brenoprata10) - [RomP][romp]: Desktop player for Windows, macOS and Linux that runs each game in its own sandbox by [@RompEmu](https://github.com/RompEmu) ### Handhelds and Steam Deck - [Gameflow Deck][gameflow-deck]: Controller-first frontend for handhelds by [@simeonradivoev](https://github.com/simeonradivoev) - [KONSORU][konsoru]: Home screen launcher for the AYN Thor with a themed UI per console by [@FabianZettl](https://github.com/FabianZettl) - [RomMix][rommix]: Big Picture-style frontend for Linux and Steam Deck by [@leclercb](https://github.com/leclercb) - [Tender][romm-tender]: Decky Loader plugin with library and save sync for Steam Deck by [@danielcopper](https://github.com/danielcopper) - [Vita RomM][vita-romm]: PS Vita homebrew client for browsing and downloading games by [@denkacn](https://github.com/denkacn) ### Consoles - [RommPS][rommps]: Client for jailbroken PS5s with game downloads and save sync by [@s0liton](https://github.com/s0liton) ### Sync - [RetroArch Sync][romm-retroarch-sync]: Sync RetroArch library with RomM by [@Covin90](https://github.com/Covin90) ### Integrations - [GGRequestz][ggrequestz]: Game discovery and request tool by [@XTREEMMAK](https://github.com/XTREEMMAK) - [romm-comm][romm-comm-discord-bot]: Discord bot by [@idio-sync](https://github.com/idio-sync) ## Support the project Consider supporting this project on Open Collective. Funds cover hosting, development, and maintenance, and we pass some along to community projects to nurture a healthy ecosystem of apps.
## Corporate Sponsors These companies support us by providing their tools for free:
## Our Friends Here are a few projects that we think you might like: - [Lutris](https://lutris.net/): Open gaming platform for Linux - [Cocoon](https://cocoon-shell.com/): Controller-first Android frontend for retro handhelds - [muOS](https://muos.dev/): Custom firmware for Anbernic and other handhelds - [RetroDECK](https://retrodeck.net/): Retro gaming on SteamOS and Linux - [Steam ROM Manager](https://steamgriddb.github.io/steam-rom-manager/): An app for managing ROMs in Steam - [Hasheous](https://hasheous.org/): Hash lookup service that maps ROMs to game metadata - [Gaseous](https://github.com/gaseous-project/gaseous-server): Another ROM manager with web-based emulator - [Playmatch](https://github.com/RetroRealm/playmatch): Microservice for matching ROM hashes to games - [EmulatorJS](https://emulatorjs.org/): An embeddable, browser-based emulator - [PortMaster](https://portmaster.games/): Native game ports for Linux handhelds - [MelonLoader](https://melonloader.co/): Universal mod loader for Unity games - [NextUI](https://nextui.loveretro.games/): MinUI-based custom firmware for TrimUI handhelds -
